content.text: If you're in a region where platforms like Stripe are unavailable, getting paid for your digital products can feel impossible. For creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and other countries, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-infrastructure-reality-check-5|COREMERCH guide to payment]] delays and high transaction fees can stifle growth. Fortunately, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-21|Cloudflare R2]] Workers combined with NOWPayments provides a robust solution for accepting [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-how-one-creator|crypto]] payments, without the traditional financial barriers. This post will guide you through the intricacies of using Cloudflare Workers for crypto payment webhooks, ensuring you can receive payments seamlessly and reliably.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Cloudflare Workers allow you to run JavaScript code in response to HTTP requests, enabling you to create custom webhooks for payment processing. This means you can automatically handle incoming crypto payments, like USDT or Bitcoin, without relying on traditional payment processors that may impose restrictions. The significance lies in infrastructure sovereignty— you maintain complete control over your transactions and data. For creators in regions facing payment bottlenecks, this setup provides a resilient and efficient alternative, ensuring that every sale goes through without unnecessary delays.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture consists of Cloudflare Workers, NOWPayments, and a data store like Supabase or Google Sheets. When a customer makes a payment, the transaction is verified on-chain by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. The webhook you set up in Cloudflare Workers listens for these payment confirmations and can trigger actions such as updating inventory or sending a digital product to the customer. This streamlined process leverages the low fees of USDT on the Tron network—costing under $0.10 per transaction—allowing creators to retain more of their earnings.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, where traditional payment gateways often fall short. Whether you sell ebooks, courses, or digital assets, the ability to accept crypto payments without the hassle of Stripe or PayPal opens up a world of opportunities. By using Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, you enable a frictionless transaction experience for your customers while also ensuring that you can quickly access your funds. This infrastructure is tailored for those who want independence from conventional financial systems.
Cloudflare Workers empower you to run custom code for payment processing without traditional constraints.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this setup include Cloudflare Workers for handling requests, NOWPayments for crypto transaction processing, and a database for storing order details. You can integrate these components seamlessly: use Cloudflare Workers to create a webhook that listens for payment confirmations from NOWPayments. Once payment is verified, this webhook can automatically log the order in your chosen database and initiate product delivery, all without manual intervention. This interconnected system ensures that you can handle orders efficiently and with minimal overhead, paving the way for scalable operations.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first, set up your Cloudflare Workers account and create a new Worker to handle payment requests. Next, integrate the NOWPayments API to facilitate crypto transactions. Follow the documentation provided by NOWPayments to configure your webhook correctly. Once your Worker is set up, test your payment flow to ensure everything works as expected. Finally, connect your database to store order information and confirm that product delivery is automated. By following these steps, you can have a fully operational payment system up and running in no time.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, you need to set up a payment processor like NOWPayments that integrates with your storefront. This setup allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies automatically. Compared to PayPal, which can take days to settle payments, USDT transactions on the Tron network are confirmed in seconds, offering significantly faster access to your funds.
USDT on the Tron network offers low transaction fees, ensuring you keep more of your earnings.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you want to learn more about setting up your payment infrastructure, check out the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This stack is designed to help creators deploy a robust payment system using Cloudflare Pages and Workers, ensuring you can handle payments efficiently.
Your Deployment Checklist

Set up a self-custody wallet first — Trust Wallet or MetaMask for USDT and other coins, with the private keys stored securely and backed up. Create a NOWPayments account and configure your wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept — start with USDT on Tron and Bitcoin. Set up a P2P exchange account in your country before you need it — Binance P2P, a local exchange, or both. Deploy your stack with NOWPayments configured and the webhook endpoint set. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm USDT arrives in your wallet within the expected confirmation time. Practice a test P2P conversion with a small amount to confirm you know the process end-to-end. When your first real sale arrives, verify it in the database, confirm delivery completed, then convert to local currency through your P2P exchange.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments, set up a payment processor like NOWPayments that supports webhooks for transaction confirmations. Integrate this with your storefront and configure your webhook to handle incoming payment notifications automatically.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?

USDT payments on the Tron network usually confirm in seconds, whereas PayPal transactions can take several days to process. This speed ensures that you have quicker access to your funds, enhancing cash flow.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?
Creators in Nigeria can convert Bitcoin to naira using P2P platforms like Binance or Patricia. These platforms facilitate easy exchanges, allowing users to quickly convert crypto into local currency.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, which is considerably lower than many traditional payment processors. This helps you retain more of your earnings for each sale.
Can I automate product delivery with this setup?
Yes, by configuring your webhook correctly, you can automate product delivery. Once a payment is confirmed, your system can trigger the delivery of your digital products without manual involvement.
